offering_description.value: Match Group offers dating apps for singles seeking dates or relationships and video chat apps for people looking to meet others. It operates mobile apps and websites that connect users through profiles, recommendations and messaging. It sells optional memberships and in-app upgrades to users and ad placements to advertisers.

primary_products.value: Dating apps; social video chat apps; digital profile boosts and priority likes

primary_services.value: Online dating and match discovery; in-app messaging; live video chat; in-app advertising

customer_segment.value: B2C: Singles seeking dates or relationships and people seeking new social connections; B2B: Brands and agencies buying in-app advertising

end_markets.value: Online dating and relationships; social discovery; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: Premium memberships with added matching, discovery and messaging features; transaction or usage fees: One-off purchases of profile boosts, priority likes and other in-app upgrades; advertising: Ad placements in selected apps and websites
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses member profiles and preferences to connect users and offers ad placements to advertisers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: Broad-market dating, relationship-focused dating, community-specific and regional dating, and social video chat

distribution_channels.value: online: Company-operated dating websites and web checkout; partners / resellers: Apple App Store and Google Play for mobile app downloads and in-app purchases

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: GDPR and state privacy laws govern user data, while consumer protection rules govern subscription billing and cancellation.
